title: 第六章 工藤家的大House
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

目暮警部把渚琰·工藤新一送回了家时已经临近午夜，还帮他叫了开锁公司。

等待开锁公司上门时，工藤新一站在院里，打量着工藤家的大房子：两层高的大型古典洋房，还带斜顶阁楼，占地面积是剑勇正人的那栋系统自带的一户建的三倍，典型的豪宅。

从今天起就是我的地盘了，桀桀桀……

“目暮警官。”工藤新一看向身边陪着他的目暮警部：“我有件事想要拜托你，在案情的调查中，不要强调我还活着这件事，可以吗？”

目暮警部闻言就理解了：“你担心那些人的继续报复？”

“是啊，虽然不知道我为什么没有事，但他们大概对自己的毒药很有信心，相信我现在已经死翘翘了。可如果让他们得知我还没有死的话，恐怕还会想要将我灭口。”工藤新一耸耸肩：“我没打算做到假死的程度，也不想太张扬，少惹点麻烦就好。”

“我明白。”目暮警部点点头：“对外披露案情的时候，会把你的情况模糊过去的。”

一边的佐藤美和子升起一个鬼主意：“如果那些不明身份的犯人来找工藤君灭口，我们是不是就可以守株待兔，埋伏在工藤君身边把他们抓起来？”

诱饵战术触发了目暮十三的心理阴影，当场脸色一黑，转头呵斥手下：“太危险了！这种计划就是置工藤老弟的安危于不顾！”

持枪、还有自研药物，虽然现在还什么都没查出来，但目暮警部总觉得工藤新一说的这两个犯人不是黑社会那么简单的。

“是。”佐藤美和子头一次见到目暮警部发这么大的脾气，被吓了一跳，缩着脖子弱气的回应道。

开锁公司来了，三两下就

“警官们进来坐一会，喝杯茶再走？”工藤新一客气了一下。

“都几点了还喝茶。”目暮警部吐槽了一句，心想这老弟该不会真被打坏脑子了吧：“早点休息吧，我先回警视厅整理一下线索。明天下午辛苦你再来一趟做模拟画像。”

“好的，路上小心目暮警官。”工藤新一不再客气，回家，关门。

踏入玄关，左边是厨房右边是客厅，走进宽敞的大客厅，

【角色：工藤新一】

【扮演者：你才是二百五】

【演出任务·主：以正义的手段的摧毁黑衣组织。】

【演出任务·支：成为战无不胜的名侦探，破解出现在眼前的一切谜题。】

【当前扮演度：5.11%】

之前在出租车上时，渚琰也看过一次系统面板，当时的扮演度是5%，看来是与警官们的这段互动增长了扮演度，前提是警官们相信了他就是工藤新一。

当然，警官们和工藤新一本来就只是普通熟人，看到一个长相一模一样的人，只要行为不是特别反常，自然不会怀疑渚琰·工藤新一的真实性。

可如果是工藤新一的同学呢？工藤新一的父母呢？还有柯南这个真工藤新一面前呢？扮演还会有这么容易吗？

不过现在渚琰关注的重点是这张角色卡的主线任务。

摧毁黑衣组织？那不得一路演到两千集去？那很带劲了。

支线任务倒是个‘稳定’的扮演度来源，破案嘛，死神小学生半年弄出几百个案子，就算一个案子只提供1%的扮演度也能起飞了。

“金色卡牌的扮演难度，就这？”

【……】系统不语，只是思考到底是哪里出了问题。

渚琰·工藤新一拍拍衣服起身，虽然时间很晚了，但现在还不是休息的时候。

毕竟他现在是工藤新一，而这里就是他的家了，对自己家的布局不熟悉怎么行呢？

工藤新一开始在家里转圈，把每一扇门都要弄清楚。

第一圈转下来，工藤宅在一楼除了客厅外还有一个起居室，一个厨房、各自独立的卫生间和盥洗室、洗衣房、和一个客房。地下室不是很大，有一个储藏室，还有一个健身区。二楼有工藤夫妇的主卧带卫生间、工藤新一的卧室、一个客房、一个洗浴一体的卫生间和一个小书房。

小书房比较简陋，主要是电脑、打印机等电子设备，而小书房对面的门就是工藤宅的大书房：直径十二米的圆筒形空间，跨越一二两层，墙壁由书架构成，宛如用书来建造的城堡。

Page (1/3)

It was almost midnight when the Megure Police Department sent Nagisa Kudo Shinichi home and called a locksmith company for him.

While waiting for the locksmith company to come to the door, Kudo Shinichi stood in the courtyard and looked at the Kudo family's big house: a large two-story classical house with a sloping roof attic. The area was three times that of Masato Kenyong's one-family house built in the system. It was a typical luxury house.

From today on, this is my territory, Jie Jie Jie...

"Officer Megure." Kudo Shinichi looked at the Megure Police Department who was accompanying him: "I have something to ask you. During the investigation of the case, please don't emphasize the fact that I am still alive, okay?"

The Mumu Police Department understood after hearing this: "Are you worried about those people's continued revenge?"

"Yes, although they don't know why I am fine, they are probably very confident in their poison and believe that I am dead now. But if they know that I am not dead yet, I am afraid they will want to kill me." Kudo Shinichi shrugged: "I don't intend to fake my death, and I don't want to be too public. I just want to cause less trouble."

"I understand." Memu Police Department nodded: "When the case is disclosed to the outside world, your situation will be blurred."

Miwako Sato on the side had an idea: "If those unidentified criminals come to Mr. Kudo to silence them, can we just wait and ambush Mr. Kudo and arrest them?"

The decoy tactic triggered the psychological shadow of Megure Thirteen. His face darkened on the spot, and he turned around and scolded his subordinates: "It's too dangerous! This kind of plan ignores the safety of brother Kudo!"

Although nothing has been found yet about holding guns and self-developed drugs, the Megure Police Department always feels that the two prisoners mentioned by Kudo Shinichi are not as simple as the underworld.

"Yes." It was the first time Miwako Sato saw the Megure Police Department lose such a big temper. She was startled and responded weakly, shrinking her neck.

The locksmith company is here, and it will be done in just a few seconds.

"Officers, come in and sit for a while, have a cup of tea before leaving?" Kudo Shinichi said politely.

"What time is it and we are still drinking tea?" Memu Police Department complained, thinking that this guy must have been really beaten. "Go to rest early. I will go back to the Metropolitan Police Department to sort out the clues. Thank you for your hard work tomorrow afternoon and come back to do the simulation portrait."

"Okay, be careful on the road, Officer Mu." Kudo Shinichi stopped being polite, went home and closed the door.

Stepping into the entrance hall, there is the kitchen on the left and the living room on the right. Walking into the spacious living room,

[Character: Kudo Shinichi]

[Player: You are the one who is 250]

[Performance mission: Main: Destroy the black organization by just means.】

[Performance mission: Branch: Become an invincible detective and solve all the mysteries that appear in front of you.】

[Current Role: 5.11%]

Zhu Yan also looked at the system panel once before when he was in a taxi. The role level at that time was 5%. It seemed that the interaction with the police officers increased the role level, provided that the police officers believed that he was Kudo Shinichi.

Of course, the police officers and Kudo Shinichi are just ordinary acquaintances. When they see a person who looks exactly the same, as long as his behavior is not particularly abnormal, they will naturally not doubt the authenticity of Nagisa and Kudo Shinichi.

But what if it’s Kudo Shinichi’s classmate?Where are Kudo Shinichi’s parents?And what about Conan, the real Kudo Shinichi?Will acting ever be this easy?

But now Zhuyan's focus is on the main mission of this character card.

Destroy the black organization?Then you can't go all the way to 2,000 episodes?That's very exciting.

Side missions are a 'stable' source of role play. As for solving crimes, the Death God has solved hundreds of cases in half a year. Even if one case only provides 1% role play, it can still take off.

"Is this how difficult it is to play the golden card?"

[...] The system remained silent, just thinking about what went wrong.

Nagisa Kudo Shinichi patted his clothes and stood up. Although it was very late, it was not the time to rest yet.

After all, he is Kudo Shinichi now, and this is his home. How can he do it if he is not familiar with the layout of his own home?

Kudo Shinichi began to walk around the house, figuring out every door.

After the first round, Kudo's house has a living room, a kitchen, separate bathroom and washroom, laundry room, and a guest room on the first floor in addition to the living room.The basement is not very large and has a storage room, as well as a fitness area.The second floor contains the Kudo couple's master bedroom with bathroom, Kudo Shinichi's bedroom, a guest room, a bathroom with integrated bath and a small study.

The small study room is relatively simple, mainly equipped with computers, printers and other electronic equipment. The door opposite the small study room is the large study room of Kudo House: a cylindrical space with a diameter of twelve meters, spanning the first and second floors, and the walls are made of bookshelves, like a castle built with books.
